Two independent, non-code checks: the two literal sha256 hashes the L05-STD-04 fix uses were recomputed from the exact migration bodies via coreutils `sha256sum`, byte-identical to what the test file hard-codes; and `migrationChecksum` itself is a plain `sha256(text with CRLF normalized)`, so the literals are a genuine independent source, not a restated computation.
